An on-screen caption re-frames this as "President Trump preparing his team for 2026". The video then cuts to a montage of clips featuring Donald Trump: looking serious in front of American flags, walking next to a fighter jet, walking with military personnel, wearing a red "MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN" hat with "45-47" on the side, walking with Melania Trump, and wearing a white hat with "USA" and "45-47". The montage ends with black-and-white shots of the White House and a helicopter, with the text "THE WHITE HOUSE" overlaid.
